name: ldap-rest
summary: Password change and account registration through ldap-rest
description: Delegates directory writes to an ldap-rest service (https://github.com/linagora/ldap-rest) instead of writing into LDAP directly. Provides two backends: a password backend (Password::LdapRest) that keeps the regular LDAP connection for reads and old-password verification but sends the modification as a PUT on the ldap-rest flat resource, and a register backend (Register::LdapRest) that needs no LDAP connection at all and creates accounts with a POST. Supports the ldap-rest core/auth/token (Bearer) and core/auth/hmac (HMAC-SHA256) authentication plugins, and optional client side RFC 3112 password hashing.
author: Xavier Guimard <yadd@debian.org>
post_install: Select "LDAP (ldap-rest)" as password module and/or register module in the Manager, then fill General Parameters > Plugins > ldap-rest parameters.
